law_record.title: Intersections
law_record.text: The prima facie speed limit shall be fifteen miles per hour when traversing any intersection or street or highway if during the last one hundred feet of his approach to such intersection the driver does not have a clear and unobstructed view of such intersection and of any traffic upon all of the streets or highways entering such intersection for a distance of one hundred feet along all such streets or highways, except on a through street or highway or at a traffic-controlled intersection.

activation_conditions: during the last 100 feet of the approach the driver lacks a clear view of the intersection and of traffic 100 feet along all entering streets
exceptions: on a through street or highway
residue: 'prima facie' is a rebuttable legal status
the view of the intersection itself is the region's sight distance; the traffic on the entering streets is read through rel.visible, which the source must supply

timing_requirements.requirement: the limit binds through the approach and the crossing
the sight condition is judged over the last 100 feet, so the speed must be reduced before entering that stretch
